description: Recommend up to a few real catalog plans for one destination. Ranks existing SKUs by trip days and usage (light≈0.5 / normal≈1.5 / heavy≈4 GB/day) — never invents prices or URLs. Prefer this for 'what should I buy?'.

days.description: Trip length in days (optional). Prefers plans whose validity is close.

limit.description: How many plans to return (1–8, default 3).

usage.description: Data intensity: light≈0.5, normal≈1.5, heavy≈4 GB/day (ranking only).

name: recommend_plans
